methodology: Each timing statistic is one median of five measured trials per process. Warmup is excluded from timing. Five seeds, not 25 trials, are the independent paired sampling units.
RSS uses the maximum observed high-water mark across all six trials, including warmup. It includes fixture setup and proof digest formatting, and does not isolate binder allocations.
The campaign runner originally summarizes RSS with the median sampled high-water mark; this report independently uses the maximum. Raw observations are retained for audit.

Confidence intervals enumerate all 5^5 paired-seed bootstrap resamples, then use type-7 2.5/97.5 percentiles of the geometric mean ratio. Student-t intervals on paired log ratios are sensitivity checks.

Intervals are descriptive with five fresh seeds, one process per seed/configuration, on one pinned host. They are not simultaneous familywise intervals or evidence about other machines, public shapes, or sustained long-lived-process RSS.
The holdout covers workers 1/4/8/16. Two workers has prior v1 screening evidence, but no v2 holdout here.

All configurations verify; bit/full proof contents are identical across their configurations and worker counts for each seed. Word proofs use their separate protocol domain; word input and source commitments match the bit baseline.

recommendations.arithmetic_kernels: All kernels improve total prover time versus baseline at each tested worker count. Folded replay adds a paired gain versus r011. Keep the public shape guard; two-worker v2 production-default validation is still separate.
recommendations.word_protocol: Strong prover and lifetime-peak RSS gains support a prover-focused default at the tested public shape, independent of worker count. Adoption explicitly accepts modest one/eight-worker verifier costs and occasional complete-payload increases. Keep it opt-in if verifier and complete-proof-size nonregression are hard requirements.
recommendations.full_replay: Supports enabling replay at 4/8/16 for prover latency; one-worker replay already exists in the baseline and the total improvement comes from commit-stage work. Strict lifetime-peak RSS nonregression remains inconclusive at 1/8/16.
recommendations.strict_all_metrics_nonregression: Not established: word verifier regresses at 1 and 8 workers, complete word payload grows for two seeds, and small RSS confidence intervals for some policies cross parity.
